criteria.quote:
keep the team-owned PostgreSQL outboxes and queues as the current transport, and
make consistent contracts, reconciliation, and replay the destination's first layer.
criteria.reason: Takes a usable near-term position against the observed fragmented recovery problem, retaining managed transport as conditional escalation. Does not withhold action pending all unknowns or approve purchasing/migration.

criteria.quote: Open-source availability does not establish supportability.
criteria.reason: Compares unchanged current, standardized current, self-operated OSS and managed with ownership and cost curves. Rejects/defer choices for stated staffing and recovery needs, not unsupported vendor facts.

criteria.quote: Six team-owned queues are not evidence of six independent failure domains.
criteria.reason: Maps shared infrastructure, identity, control planes and capacity; assigns per-team data/effect correctness and internal operations under managed service. Respects two operators, names unestablished pager/incident owner coverage as a gate, and avoids assuming provider support handles applications.

criteria.quote:
Storage starts with average events/second × average
encoded bytes/event × retention seconds, then adds the measured effects of replication, indexes,
backups, retries, and replay copies.
criteria.reason: Treats 200k events/s as a planning scenario, not measured capability; includes fanout, replay, staff, support, exit and parallel-running costs. Data path covers storage, logs, backups, support/export and approved-region recovery; product teams retain business data and reconciled export/exit obligations.

criteria.quote:
Observed peak exceeds two-thirds of the measured stable capacity ceiling, or the demand
  forecast reaches that ceiling inside the measured migration lead time.
criteria.reason: Concrete headroom and lead-time triggers accompany falsifiers for recovery, staffing budget, vendor residency/cost and semantic requirements. Conditions are proposed thresholds to validate rather than fabricated metrics.

criteria.quote: Stop at the cap with a decision record, including unresolved evidence.
criteria.reason: Four-week capped evaluation assigns operators and two team delegates; baseline and recovery rehearsal target whether standardization actually fixes the incident before transport commitment. Later stream-scoped shadow pilot has effect fencing, rollback, independently useful phases and explicit expensive exit decisions.

criteria.quote:
There is currently no defensible dollar
estimate, cost winner, or vendor SLA comparison.
criteria.reason: Fixture inputs are sourced; decisions, capacities and integration hypotheses are unverified. Vendor duties require evidence; no tests, pricing research or implementations are falsely reported.

additional_observations: Ends with an unsolicited Learning line absent from the frozen candidate's required packet. This is a shape/ambient-instruction observation, not a material decision failure; the harness cannot attribute it to candidate versus generic host instructions.
The answer is extensive; length was not a frozen pass threshold. Final efficiency reporting uses measured text characters and whitespace-separated words, not claimed runtime token usage.
limitations: Manual outcome grading by the case author; no second independent grade yet.
No actual capacity, cost, vendor or residency evidence was collected, by task design.
